Claim 13 (Currently amended): A flexible respiratory gas tube arrangement for supplying a respiratory gas to a person, the tube arrangement comprising: a flexible tube; a heater to heat the gas as it is delivered through the tube; a first connector provided to one end of the tube and adapted to connect the tube with a breathing mask; and a second connector provided to the other end of the tube and adapted to connect the tube with a CPAP device, said second connector including a first portion that provides a respiratory gas passage and a second portion that provides integrated contact elements by which power is supplied to said heater, wherein said contact elements are adapted to be engaged with a power supply provided on the CPAP device for supplying power to said heater, __wherein the contact elements are electrically isolated from the respiratory gas passage__.

Claim 14 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, further comprising an insulating sheathing body __that thermally insulates the flexible tube__.

Claim 15 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 14, wherein the insulating sheathing body is removably attachable to the flexible tube __via mechanical fasteners__.

Claim 16 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 14, wherein the heater is __positioned within and thermally coupled to__ the sheathing body.

Claim 17 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 14, wherein said sheathing body includes a multi-layered design __comprising an inner thermal layer and an outer protective layer__.

Claim 18 (Previously presented): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the tube is a heatable respiratory gas tube.

Claim 19 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 14, wherein the heater is __electrically connected to and positioned within__ the tube.

Claim 20 (Previously presented): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein said second connector further includes a pressure measuring tube connection.

Claim 21 (Previously presented): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, further comprising a respiratory gas humidifier.

Claim 22 (Previously presented): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 21, wherein said humidifier is adapted to be connected to a water source via a humidification line.

Claim 23 (Previously presented): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 21, wherein said humidifier is in the form of a flexible tube piece disposed between the breathing mask and the respiratory gas tube.

Claim 24 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the flexible tube is made from a spirally reinforced plastic material __that provides structural rigidity while maintaining flexibility__.

Claim 25 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the heater is an electrical resistance heater __that generates heat in response to electrical current supplied through the contact elements__.

Claim 26 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein each contact element extends generally parallel to a longitudinal axis of the gas passage such that both an electric and pneumatic connection is provided when the connector is connected to the CPAP device, __and wherein the contact elements do not obstruct gas flow through the gas passage__.

Claim 27 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein each __contact element__ is provided within the second portion.

Claim 28 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the first portion is tubular and the second portion extends outwardly from the first portion __in a radial direction__.

Claim 29 (Currently amended): A connector for connecting a CPAP device to a respiratory gas tube arrangement for supplying a respiratory gas to a person, the respiratory gas tube arrangement including a heater, the connector comprising: a first portion that provides a respiratory gas passage; and a second portion that provides integrated contact elements by which power is supplied to the heater, wherein each contact element extends generally parallel to a longitudinal axis of the gas passage such that both an electric and pneumatic connection is provided when the connector is connected to the CPAP device, __and wherein the contact elements are electrically isolated from the respiratory gas passage__.

Claim 30 (Currently amended): A connector according to claim 29, wherein each __contact element__ is provided within the second portion.

Claim 31 (Currently amended): A connector according to claim 29, wherein the first portion is tubular and the second portion extends outwardly from the first portion __in a radial direction__.
